newsitem.title: USA: Oneita in talks to restructure credit woes.
newsitem.headline: Oneita in talks to restructure credit woes.

text.p: Oneita Industries Inc said Thursday that its institutional lenders have demanded immediate repayment of a $6.15 million loan.

The company said that it has been in talks with the holders of $57 million of its revolving credit to restructure the loan, and that the lenders said that they are willing to continue these negotiations. It said however, that no assurances can be given that these talks will be successful.
Oneita makes and sells activewear and baby clothes.
